Actually normaliseWhitespace likely collapses multiple spaces to single and also trim? Ensure tn.getWholeText() equals "". - testSplitTextNegativeOffset: expect IllegalArgumentException. - testSplitTextOffsetTooBig: offset == length should throw IllegalArgumentException. - testCreateFromEncoded: TextNode tn = TextNode.createFromEncoded("<div>"); assertEquals("
", tn.getWholeText()); - testNormaliseWhitespace: static method. - testStripLeadingWhitespace: static method. - testLastCharIsWhitespace: test with StringBuilder. - testOuterHtml: Build Document with element, add TextNode as child, set prettyPrint true, check output includes escaped characters. Actually outerHtml of TextNode will escape < to <. So outerHtml of div should be "
\n a<b>c\n
" with indentation. But to avoid complexity, just test that outerHtml of TextNode contains escaped characters. String html = tn.outerHtml(); assertTrue(html.contains("<"));.
